set: A: the page at rest, its result, and eight of the keys, as a web page

issues.where: the whole central area of the step page at rest
issues.what: at rest the page offers no visible first action: one narrow copy block on the left, a silent tube device on the right, and a large empty centre; nothing near the device mouth tells the user what to do first
issues.fix: give the rest state one clear affordance: a short instruction line at the tube mouth (what is expected and what happens next) or a visible start control, so the page is usable before anything moves

issues.where: the scrolled rest view, below the ASSESSMENT COMPLETE plaque and Continue button
issues.what: the lower half of the view is an uninterrupted blank beige expanse; the completion message and button float in the top with all content abandoned beneath them, reading as an unfinished layout rather than a composed confirmation view
issues.fix: compose the completion state as a compact-centered unit (or fill the lower area with relevant content) so the scrolled state does not look like empty leftover page

issues.what: completed steps 1 and 2 are visually identical to upcoming steps 4 and 5, so progress (current vs done vs to-do) is not legible
issues.fix: give completed steps a distinct done state (check mark, filled or dimmed finish) so the stepper reads as one current step, two completed, two remaining

issues.where: the left end of the large circular wireform ramp, above the Student Loans sign
issues.what: the ramp terminates in a grey clamp block hanging in empty space with no post or socket to the surface, so on close inspection the mechanism reads unanchored, like a stray layout element
issues.fix: add a support post or a bracket tying the ramp end down to the surface so the termination reads as engineered

issues.where: the three giant coffee-lid bumpers in the middle of the field
issues.what: their top faces are flat, featureless pale discs; next to the densely detailed surroundings the largest targets on the field look like untextured placeholders
issues.fix: add surface detail consistent with the rest of the art (moulded rim, logo emboss, lid sip-slot shading) so they match the material quality of neighbouring pieces
